comparison.objective: Fit a carriage over the open end of a T-rail and push it past a spring plunger to the stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Undercut slide-fit alignment, constrained pushing through a detent, and clean release.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage is captured on the rail, past the plunger, within 3 mm of the stop, level, still, and released.
comparison.reason: The record tests one-time rail insertion and detent passage. It lacks tool-mediated unlocking, iterative setting selection, and force/energy-qualified impact cycles.
